content.text:
`go test ./...` now passes. I changed only the three source files; the test files are untouched.

The three bugs:

1. **`cart.go` (`Total`)**: the discount was added instead of subtracted. It now returns `total - total*discountPercent/100`, so 1300 with 10% off gives 1170.
2. **`stats.go` (`Mean`)**: the sum was divided as integers before converting to float, so `Mean([1 2])` returned 1. It now converts both operands to float first: `float64(sum) / float64(len(xs))`.
3. **`text.go` (`Truncate`)**: it sliced by bytes, which split the multi-byte Cyrillic characters. It now works on runes, and I added a guard so `n <= 0` returns an empty string instead of panicking.

I did not run `go vet`, because the sandbox asked for approval on that command.
